description: Blinkit is India's leading instant delivery platform that delivers groceries, essentials, and everyday items in under 10 minutes using a dark-store model.
work_culture: Engineers design scalable systems under high traffic
Flat hierarchy with direct access to leadership

interview_process.name: Online Assessment
interview_process.description: 2-3 DSA problems. Array, String, Graph, DP level questions.

interview_process.name: DSA Technical Interview
interview_process.description: Live coding round. Medium to Hard LeetCode level. Interviewer checks approach, edge cases, complexity.

interview_process.name: Low Level Design (LLD)
interview_process.description: Design classes, relationships, and UML. Examples: Parking Lot, Library System, Ride Sharing.

interview_process.name: High Level Design (HLD)
interview_process.description: Design scalable systems. Examples: Design Blinkit delivery system, URL shortener at scale, notification system.

interview_process.name: HR Round
interview_process.description: Culture fit, career goals, situational questions.

key_engineering_challenges: Real-time inventory management across 500+ dark stores
Order routing and delivery partner assignment at scale
Demand forecasting using ML at hyper-local level
